🥚 France just held a world championship for boiled eggs with mayonnaise. Yes, this is a real thing!

Near Paris, 17 chefs — including Michelin-star winners — competed to make the best simple boiled eggs with mayo.

It was serious: each chef had to prepare at least 200 portions. Judges scored the sauce texture, taste, presentation, and how perfectly the eggs were cooked. Organizers say the ideal time is exactly 8 minutes and 40 seconds.

Chefs used pink champagne jelly, pickled grapes, and other fancy extras. Even an 83-year-old French woman took part.

The winner is Parisian chef Hugo Riboulet from the restaurant Groot La Tourte.

posts.text:
🇺🇸🇨🇳🇷🇺 There's a CIVIL WAR inside the Trump administration. The tariffs are just the latest casualty.

Doomberg, founder of the most widely read finance newsletter on Substack, says the chaos is structural, not random.

Two factions. The Pentagon wing wants re-industrialization. The Wall Street wing wants to protect the dollar. You can't have both.

Every time Trump imposes tariffs, markets crash and he blinks. The reserve currency makes U.S. manufacturing uncompetitive by design. The dollar's strength is the Rust Belt's weakness.

The Nvidia affair proves the point. Pentagon leaks against Jensen Huang. Markets tank. Trump calls the Nvidia board personally and reverses course. That's not strategy.

On China: the U.S. vastly overestimates Chinese dependency on American consumers. China has escalation dominance. And a far higher pain tolerance. 

Trump has 18 months before lame duck. Xi has until 2030.

On Russia warning Estonia: the first time in decades Moscow has formally warned a NATO member that war is close. History says when Russia formally warns, war follows.

The deeper problem: the U.S. is agreement-incapable. Any deal Trump signs can be reversed by the next president in weeks. 

Game theory says conflicts that can't be resolved diplomatically must be won militarily. That's the direction of travel.

@DoombergT
